digest.component_or_area: plan structure validation and clarity analysis
propositions: Empty whitespace-joined Acceptance Criteria checklist items must fail standalone clarity and block P1 readiness deterministically.

Sentinel tokens (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) in active execution sections must fail clarity when they start lines, follow colons/equals, or follow is/remains/left, unless suppressed by same-line negation terms.
Fenced code blocks and inline backtick-quoted code must not trigger sentinel rule matches.
Suppression terms (no, zero, remove, delete, reject, forbid, must not, without) on the same line as a sentinel must prevent the defect from firing.
Shared pure parser structure must preserve existing clarity scores and ticket-type exemptions while enforcing deterministic hard floors across both standalone clarity and plan-review gates.
